description: Use Kolmogorov complexity estimates to identify TMs whose behavior is maximally complex. High-scoring BB machines should have near-maximal algorithmic complexity relative to their state count.
mathematical_formalization: K(output(M)) / |M| should be maximized for BB champions; approximate via compression ratio
implementation_hypothesis: Score TMs by compression ratio of their output tape; machines whose output is hardest to compress are most likely to be near-optimal
experiment_seed: Simulate 10K random 6-state TMs, compute compression ratio of output, correlate with sigma score
